description: ScriptUI control creation and property reads; auto-closed
source: var w = new Window('palette'); var s = w.add('statictext', undefined, 'label'); var e = w.add('edittext', undefined, 'initial'); var cb = w.add('checkbox', undefined, 'check'); cb.value = true; var out = {st: s.text, et: e.text, checked: cb.value}; w.close(); return out;
